description: 提取 CNN Heroes 人物页面的资料，支持现代文章及旧版归档页面。

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - extract_profile   Extract hero profile information from a single CNN Hero page
  - extract_profiles   Extract profiles from multiple CNN Hero pages
  - check_urls   Check if CNN Hero page URLs are accessible

url.description: URL of the CNN Hero page

urls.description: List of CNN Hero page URLs
